why: The figures repeat in a group of three: figure 5 is the same as figure 2. So figure 4 must be the same type as figure 1: a square with a circle inside and a small cross inside the circle. Option 5 shows exactly this. Option 4 has the cross touching the circle edge, and options 1 and 2 have big crosses.
trick: If a later figure copies an earlier one, the series repeats - use the repeat length to fill the gap.
